A point of view,

projects.title: Nu Labs
projects.subtitle: One identity. A useful range.
projects.summary: A black-and-white identity that moves from quiet clarity to expressive form.
projects.challenge: Build a recognisable system around the supplied three-part symbol, with enough range for digital, print and physical applications.
projects.direction: Keep the signature fixed. Let scale, material, typography and shaped panels create the variation.
projects.detail: The system combines Instrument Sans, an exact logo lockup and a restrained neutral palette. A straight cut meeting a soft curve becomes a recurring way to frame content.
projects.outcome: An identity system and a set of concept applications.
projects.image_note: Application renders are visual concepts, not production samples.

projects.title: Studio Index
projects.subtitle: Less searching. More making.
projects.summary: A proposed workspace for bringing briefs, decisions and project files into one clear view.
projects.challenge: Explore how a small creative team could see what matters today without losing the context behind a decision.
projects.direction: Give the active project a clear centre. Keep tasks, references and decisions within reach, with quiet visual hierarchy.
projects.detail: The concept uses a compact project index and focused detail panels. It is a design exploration that can be developed into a tested product.
projects.outcome: A fictional product direction presented to demonstrate interface thinking.
projects.image_note: Concept interface. No client, launch or user results are implied.

projects.title: Open House
projects.subtitle: Find a place. Make a plan.
projects.summary: A proposed digital experience for discovering creative spaces and planning a visit.
projects.challenge: Make place, availability and practical details easy to understand while preserving the character of each space.
projects.direction: Pair generous photography with a compact, readable information layer. Let people explore first and make practical decisions with confidence.
projects.detail: The study connects a visual directory to a useful detail view, bringing location context, amenities and next steps into one reading flow.
projects.outcome: A fictional service concept, available for further design and development.
projects.image_note: Concept imagery and interface. Spaces and availability are illustrative.

studio.label: Studio / Our perspective
studio.headline:
Clear thinking.
Human perspective.
studio.intro: Nu Labs is a meeting point for design and software. We connect the shape of an idea with the way it needs to work.
studio.statement:
The detail matters.
So does the bigger picture.
studio.body: A good experience should hold together, from the words that introduce it to the last interaction. We look for a strong central idea, then carry it carefully through the work.

values.title: Ask better questions.
values.body: Understand the people, the purpose and the practical limits before choosing a direction.

values.title: Make decisions visible.
values.body: Use sketches, prototypes and clear conversations to make progress tangible.

values.title: Care about the ordinary.
values.body: A useful form, a clear label and a well-timed transition deserve as much thought as the first impression.

perspective.headline:
Make room

perspective.body: We believe Black creative and technical excellence deserves to be seen, valued and given room to lead. Our ambition is to make thoughtful work with a perspective of our own.
perspective.status: Proposed brand belief grounded in the user’s stated goal; not an ownership or certification claim.

services.label: Services / From thought to working form
services.headline:
Think it through.
Make it happen.
services.intro: Start with one focused challenge or bring the whole picture. Strategy, design and development work best when the decisions connect.

services.title: Find the right idea.
services.name: Strategy
services.body: Before making more, get clear on what matters. We shape the brief, the structure and the decisions that give the work direction.
services.outcome: A clear direction for what comes next.

services.title: Give it a distinct form.
services.name: Design
services.body: Turn that direction into something people can recognise, understand and enjoy using. Every element has a part to play.
services.outcome: A coherent experience, from first impression to fine detail.

services.title: Make it work in the world.
services.name: Development
services.body: Bring the design into a working experience, with care for the details people notice and the foundations they rely on.
services.outcome: A working product that can keep moving forward.

steps.title: Understand
steps.body: Define the problem, the people and what a useful result would look like.

steps.title: Explore
steps.body: Make the options tangible through concepts, prototypes and early decisions.

steps.title: Build
steps.body: Bring the chosen direction into a working experience and refine it through use.

steps.title: Refine
steps.body: Review what is working, address what is not and plan the next improvement.

faq.question: Where should we start?
faq.answer: With the problem you want to solve. A short description of the business, the people using the work and the result you want is enough to begin.

faq.question: Can we start with a focused piece of work?
faq.answer: Yes. A clear identity, a single website or a product prototype can be a useful first step. The scope should fit the need.

faq.question: What information should a brief include?
faq.answer: Share the goal, the audience, any existing material, a preferred timeline and a budget range if you have one. It is fine if some of that is still taking shape.

implementation_rules: All headings, navigation and reading copy remain semantic flat DOM text, separate from the cinematic background.
Screen-reader order remains headline, proposition, offer, work, studio and contact, even if display text is split visually.
Do not give fictional projects false clients, outcomes, awards, testimonials, device statistics or fabricated screenshots with real transactions.
Do not display live_success copy without confirmed server receipt. A local preview or clipboard action must remain explicit.
Keep optional budget values as client enquiry ranges, never pricing claims.
Service offers are a proposed scope from the approved positioning. Do not add regulated specialist services or unsupported certifications.
